itinerary.desc: Arrive in Guwahati, the gateway to Northeast India. After your arrival, transfer to Shillong, which is about a 3-4 hour drive (approximately 100 km). itinerary.desc: In the morning, visit Shillong Peak for panoramic views of the city and the surrounding Khasi Hills. Explore Elephant Falls, a beautiful waterfall located on the outskirts of Shillong. Visit the Don Bosco Museum to learn about the culture and traditions of Northeast India. Head to Mawphlang Sacred Forest, a lush green forest with significant cultural importance for the Khasi tribe. Explore Laitlum Canyons for breathtaking views and great photo opportunities. In the evening, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of Umiam Lake (also called Barapani), a stunning reservoir just outside Shillong.

itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive to Cherrapunji (approximately 2-3 hours). In the afternoon, visit Nohkalikai Falls, one of the tallest waterfalls in India. Explore Mawsmai Cave, an impressive limestone cave that is well-lit and easy to explore. Visit the Seven Sisters Waterfalls, a series of waterfalls located in the area. Stay overnight in Cherrapunji and enjoy the cool, misty environment of this serene hill station.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Cherrapunji Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit the Living Root Bridges in Nongriat Village, one of the unique natural wonders of Meghalaya. You can take a short trek to reach the famous double-decker root bridge. Explore Dainthlen Waterfall and Thangkharang Park, which offers stunning views of Bangladesh’s plains. Relax and enjoy the evening in the tranquility of Cherrapunji.

itinerary.desc: In the morning, drive to Mawlynnong village (2-3 hours), known as the cleanest village in Asia. Enjoy a walk around the village and admire its cleanliness and beautiful surroundings. Visit the Sky View in Mawlynnong, a bamboo structure offering panoramic views of the region and Bangladesh. Continue your journey to Dawki (about 1-1.5 hours), famous for its crystal-clear river Umngot. Enjoy a boat ride in the river, known for its transparent waters. Return to Shillong for the night.

In the evening, enjoy a Brahmaputra River Cruise, which offers beautiful views of the river, especially at sunset.

name: Meghalaya Highland Holiday
tagline: Day 1: Arrival in Guwahati & Transfer to Shillong (3-4hrs/100kms)

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Guwahati & Transfer to Shillong (3-4hrs/100kms)
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Guwahati via flight or train. From there, transfer to Shillong, the capital of Meghalaya, which takes approximately 3-4 hours by road. Upon arrival in Shillong, check in to your hotel, relax, and freshen up. In the evening, explore Police Bazar, a lively market area, and take a peaceful stroll around Ward’s Lake. Enjoy some local delicacies for dinner and stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Shillong Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Start your day with a visit to Shillong Peak, where you can enjoy panoramic views of the city and the surrounding Khasi Hills. Next, explore Elephant Falls, one of the most beautiful waterfalls in Shillong. Afterward, head to the Don Bosco Museum to learn more about the culture and traditions of Northeast India. Continue your exploration by visiting the Mawphlang Sacred Forest, a lush green forest of cultural significance to the Khasi tribe. Later, visit Laitlum Canyons, which offers breathtaking views and great photo opportunities. In the evening, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of Umiam Lake, also known as Barapani, a stunning reservoir just outside Shillong. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Shillong to Cherrapunji (2hrs/60kms)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, embark on a drive to Cherrapunji (approximately 2-3 hours). Once you arrive, visit Nohkalikai Falls, one of the tallest waterfalls in India. Afterward, explore Mawsmai Cave, a well-lit limestone cave that is easy to explore. Next, visit the Seven Sisters Waterfalls, a series of stunning waterfalls in the region. In the evening, enjoy the cool, misty atmosphere of this hill station and stay overnight in Cherrapunji at a hotel or homestay.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Cherrapunji Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Start your day with a visit to the famous Living Root Bridges in Nongriat Village. A short trek will lead you to the double-decker root bridge, a rewarding sight. Continue  to Dainthlen Waterfall, one of the most picturesque falls in the area, before heading to Thangkharang Park, which offers stunning views of the plains of Bangladesh. In the evening, relax and enjoy the peaceful ambiance of Cherrapunji. Stay overnight in Cherrapunji.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Cherrapunji to Mawlynnong & Dawki (2hrs/60kms) – Return to Shillong
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive to Mawlynnong Village (approx. 2 hours), known as the cleanest village in Asia. Walk around the village, enjoying its cleanliness and beautiful surroundings. Visit the Sky View in Mawlynnong, a bamboo structure offering panoramic views of the region, including a view of Bangladesh. Continue your journey to Dawki (about 1-1.5 hours), where you can enjoy a boat ride on the Umngot River, famous for its crystal-clear waters. Afterward, return to Shillong by evening and enjoy an overnight stay there.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Shillong to Kaziranga National Park (5hrs/200kms)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out from your Shillong hotel and drive to Kaziranga National Park, which takes approximately 5 hours. Upon arrival, check in to your resort, freshen up, and relax. You may also enjoy an optional safari or simply relax in the serene environment of your resort. In the evening, enjoy leisure time at the resort or explore the surroundings. Stay overnight in Kaziranga.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Kaziranga National Park Safari & Departure
itinerary.desc: Start your day with an early morning elephant safari, followed by a jeep safari in the park to spot the famous one-horned rhinoceros, tigers, elephants, and various birds. After the safari, visit the Kaziranga Orchid Park to explore its diverse range of orchids. After breakfast, check out from your hotel and drive back to Guwahati (approx. 5 hours). Upon arrival, transfer to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

Matho Monastery: Located around 26 kilometers away from Leh, on the picturesque Indus Valley, Matho Monastery is a Tibetan Buddhist monastery built under the Saskya Monastic Establishment. It was constructed around 500 years ago. Notes : All entrance fees to Monastries and Monuments are on Direct Payment Basis, payable by the customer. Overnight stay at Hotel City Palace

itinerary.title: Day 3 - Excursion to Pangong Lake
itinerary.desc: After an early breakfast, we leave for Pangong Lake through Changla pass (5486 Mtrs). The long easy ascent takes you to Changla pass through its winding roads passing through Sakti Village. Stop at the Changla Pass for a quick photograph session. The Chang La (also known as Changla) is one of the highest mountain roads of the country. The pass, guarded and maintained by the Indian Army (due its proximity to Chinese border), is covered with snow throughout the year. This road is usually open all year, but it can be closed anytime when the access is not cleared of snow. The Changla Pass is the main gateway for the Changthang Plateau situated in the Himalayas. The pass is located on the 134 km-long (83 mi) road between the Pangong Lake and Leh. Road closures can be frequent. Later, we drive down to the village of Tangtse, where you can relax for a cup of tea. Leaving Tangtse for Pangong you pass through few small villages of Changthang and finally you can have a sudden view of the Pangong Lake situated at 14,000 feet (4,267 m). This famous blue brackish Lake of Pangong is 5/6 Kms wide and over 133 Kms long with half of it's running the other side of the "INDO CHINA BORDER". Overnight stay at Hotel City Palace

itinerary.title: Day 4 -  Excursion to Nubra Valley
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, we proceed to Nubra Valley. The road journey from Leh to Nubra Valley passes over Khardung La (The Highest Motorable Road In The World). Khardung La: The Highest Motor able Road in The World at 5,602 Mtrs. / 18,390 Ft, around 39 km from Leh. From the pass, one can see all the way south over the Indus valley to seemingly endless peaks and ridges of the Zanskar range, and north to the giants of the Saser massif. The views from the top of the pass are amazing. Later, we visit Hunder and Disket Monastery. Diskit monastery also known as Diskit Gompa is situated in the Nubra valley of Ladakh. This Buddhist center is one of the oldest and largest monasteries in Leh Ladakh. The Diskit monastery was founded by Changzem Tserab Zangpo in the 14th century. The prime attraction of the Diskit monastery is 100 foot high Maitreya Buddha statue, which was inaugurated by the holy Dalai Lama. Overnight stay at Hotel City Palace Notes : All entrance fees to Monastries and Monuments are on Direct Payment Basis, payable by the customer.

itinerary.title: Day 5 - Half Day Excursion to Sham Valley
itinerary.desc: After breakfast drive downstream along the River Indus on Leh - Kargil Highway and start sightseeing with: Hall of Fame: The Hall of Fame, located near the Leh Airfield, is a museum constructed as well as maintained by the Indian Army in the memory of the soldiers who had lost their lives during the Indo-Pak wars. It is also termed as a memorial for the war heros. This building consists of two floors. While on the ground floor, there is information about the brave soldiers and a souvenir shop but on the first floor, there are artifacts of various wars (mainly Kargil war) such as the weapons used during the war and some important documents, related to the same. There is another section dedicated to the Siachen glacier. Gurudwara Patthar Sahib: Situated 25 miles from Leh in Ladakh region in Jammu and Kashmir, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib stands. Overnight stay at Hotel City Palace Notes : All entrance fees to Monastries and Monuments are on Direct Payment Basis, payable by the customer.

itinerary.title: Day 6 - Departure from Leh
itinerary.desc: We thank you for your patronage and ensures a punctual transfer to Domestic Airport to catch the flight for your onward Destination with a lifetime memory.

name: Rajasthan Royal Affair
tagline: Elevate your Rajasthan experience with upgraded accommodations and a premium Sedan. Explore Jodhpur’s vibrant markets and Udaipur’s iconic lakes in style.

itinerary.title: Day 1 - Arrival in Jodhpur & Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Jodhpur, check-in at a 3-star hotel. Visit Mehrangarh Fort , Jaswant Thada , Umaid Bhawan Palace , Clock Tower , and Sardar Market . Evening -  Explore bustling markets for local shopping.

itinerary.title: Day 2 - Jodhpur Exploration & Transfer to Udaipur

itinerary.title: Day 3 - Full-Day Udaipur Sightseeing

name: Rajasthan Desert Diaries
tagline: A 4-night journey exploring the Blue City of Jodhpur and the golden dunes of Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 1 - Arrival in Jodhpur
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Jodhpur airport, then transfer to the hotel. Check in to your hotel and freshen up. In the afternoon, visit Mehrangarh Fort, one of India’s largest forts. Explore the museum and take in the stunning views of the 'Blue City.' In the evening, take a stroll through the Clock Tower and Sardar Market for local handicrafts and snacks. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 - Full Day Sightseeing in Jodhpur
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, drive to visit Umaid Bhawan Palace, a royal palace that’s also a luxury hotel and museum. Explore Jaswant Thada, a white marble cenotaph offering serene views. Visit Rao Jodha Desert Rock Park and Mandore Gardens. Enjoy some local handicraft shopping as Jodhpur is famous for its handicrafts—take time to explore local shops and artisans. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 - Jodhpur to Jaisalmer (5 Hrs / 270 Kms)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Jaisalmer. Upon arrival in Jaisalmer, complete the check-in process and relax. Visit Gandisar Lake for boating and enjoy the sunset views. Walk through the local markets for unique handicrafts. Overnight stay at the hotel in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 4 - Full Day Sightseeing in Jaisalmer
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive to local sightseeing points - · Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Quila) · Patwon Ki Haveli · Salim Singh Ki Haveli Experience a desert safari at Sam Sand Dunes, including a camel ride. Check in for your tent stay and enjoy an overnight stay in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 5 - Departure
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out from the camp and drive to the airport. Board your pre-booked flight with beautiful memories.

name: Uttarakhand Explorer
